name: Salem & Cape Ann
summary: Witch-trial history and maritime fortunes in Salem, then the rocky artists' harbors of Cape Ann.
seasonalTip: October in Salem is peak 'Haunted Happenings' — atmospheric but very crowded; go early in the day.

lodging.name: The Hawthorne Hotel, Salem
lodging.blurb: A 1925 landmark on the common, named for Nathaniel Hawthorne.

foodMustTry.name: Fresh fried clams on Cape Ann
foodMustTry.blurb: Whole-belly clams at a Gloucester or Essex clam shack — the real thing.

days.label: Day 8 — Salem
days.summary: A short drive north from Boston into witch-trial history.

item.title: Salem Witch Trials Memorial & Old Burying Point
item.blurb: A quiet, sobering memorial beside the colonial burying ground — the human story behind the 1692 trials.

item.title: Peabody Essex Museum
item.blurb: A superb art and maritime museum, including a relocated Qing-dynasty house.

item.title: The House of the Seven Gables

location.name: The House of the Seven Gables

item.blurb: The 1668 mansion that inspired Hawthorne's novel, on the harbor.

days.label: Day 9 — Cape Ann
days.summary: The rocky cape north of Salem — fishing harbors and artists' light.

item.title: Rockport & Motif No. 1
item.blurb: The red fishing shack said to be the most-painted building in America, plus Bearskin Neck's galleries and shops.

item.title: Gloucester & the Fisherman's Memorial
item.blurb: America's oldest fishing port and the 'Man at the Wheel' statue honoring those lost at sea.

days.label: Day 10 — Drive south to Plymouth
days.summary: Around Boston to the South Shore.

commute.scenicNote: Skirts Boston — time it outside rush hour.
